description: Make the 115-field Maker Valuation contract and edit flow lossless from the complete form through Neon persistence and back into the form.
steps: Read context.json and this feature file first. In e:/codefiles/va2/src/db/schema.ts align boundaryPropertyNorth/South/East/West and boundarySiteNorth/South/East/West with the verified Neon/migration varchar(255) type; do not create a destructive migration or change live data.

In e:/codefiles/va2/src/components/case/MakerValuationForm.tsx create or extract a complete typed 115-field form-value/default adapter. Accept a complete MakerValuation for edit, normalize nullable/numeric values to strings and date values to YYYY-MM-DD, reset when initialValues changes, preserve the existing zod resolver, calculated-value behavior, and api_createMakerValuation call.

In e:/codefiles/va2/src/routes/_app/cases.$caseId.index.tsx pass the complete fetched makerValuation to the edit form rather than projecting five Basic fields. Keep the existing query and auth/session behavior.

In e:/codefiles/va2/src/components/case/MakerValuationForm.tsx repair Dev Auto-Fill to use exact existing select options and populate every canonical field, including deterministic calculated values; keep rateRange as an open numeric input.

In e:/codefiles/va2/src/server/api.server.ts preserve requireServerUser(token, MAKER), the upsert, and PDF generation while ensuring create and update mappings and mapMakerValuationRow remain one-to-one for all 115 fields with explicit null/numeric/date normalization. Leave e:/codefiles/va2/src/data/makerValuation.functions.ts auth/session-token behavior intact unless a type-only adjustment is required.

Run the feature verification commands and update this FEAT file status to completed, recording implementation and verification findings needed by later features. Commit locally on the current branch; never push.
acceptance_criteria: The Drizzle boundary declarations match the verified Neon table and migration types; all 115 canonical field names remain present exactly once.
Create and update persistence plus row mapping preserve all 115 fields without renames or dropped values, while existing Maker authentication remains enforced.
Editing a fetched valuation hydrates all 115 values, including numeric columns as strings, dates as YYYY-MM-DD, and nulls as empty strings.
Dev Auto-Fill assigns valid values for every canonical field and all select values are members of their existing option arrays; rateRange remains numeric/open.
The form builds and type-checks without changing unrelated behavior.
verification: From e:/codefiles/va2 run npx tsc --noEmit and expect exit code 0.
From e:/codefiles/va2 run npm run build and expect exit code 0.
With a valid Maker session, use Dev Auto-Fill, save, reload the case, open Edit, and verify all 115 fields are populated; save a changed value from each major section and reload it again.
findings: Implementation: aligned all eight boundary side columns to varchar(255) without a migration; added a typed 115-field edit adapter with nullable/numeric/date normalization and reset-on-prop-change; passed the complete MakerValuation into edit mode; corrected all Dev Auto-Fill select values and deterministic calculated values while retaining open numeric rateRange; normalized storage input and mapped database numerics/dates back to string-shaped domain values while preserving requireServerUser(token, MAKER), upsert, PDF generation, and session-token wrappers. Verification: npx tsc --noEmit passed; npm run build passed; adapter field count is 115 and auto-fill assignment count is 116 including caseId; npm run lint remains blocked by the repository's pre-existing broad Prettier/CRLF violations (5,453 errors across the full tree), not TypeScript errors. Manual valid-Maker-session save/reload/edit/PDF smoke test was not executable in this step because no authenticated browser session was available; later feature verification should run it.
